description: This Lua script tests bitwise operations, including custom bitwise library implementation, coercion, and edge cases. It also verifies external 'bit32' library functions.

methods.name: bit.bnot
methods.description: Bitwise NOT operation, returning complement masked to 32 bits.

methods.name: bit.band
methods.description: Bitwise AND operation supporting multiple arguments.

methods.name: bit.bor
methods.description: Bitwise OR operation supporting multiple arguments.

methods.name: bit.bxor
methods.description: Bitwise XOR operation supporting multiple arguments.

methods.name: bit.btest
methods.description: Tests if bitwise AND of arguments is non-zero.

methods.name: bit.lshift
methods.description: Left shift operation masked to 32 bits.

methods.name: bit.rshift
methods.description: Right shift operation masked to 32 bits.

methods.name: bit.arshift
methods.description: Arithmetic right shift with sign extension.

methods.name: bit.extract
methods.description: Extract bits from a number at specified position and width.

methods.name: bit.replace
methods.description: Replace bits in a number at specified position and width.
